title: Convey a Message
sub: Clear, polite and direct ways to pass on information.

cards.def:
to communicate an idea or feeling
हिंदी: व्यक्त करना / पहुँचाना
examples: He conveyed the news gently.
The letter conveys our thanks.
Her smile conveyed more than any words could.
Use simple slides to convey your main idea to the client.

cards.def:
to share information with someone
हिंदी: संवाद करना / बताना
examples: We communicate by email.
She communicates clearly.
Our manager communicates changes in the Monday team call.
Babies communicate by crying before they learn to talk.

cards.def:
to give someone information
हिंदी: सूचित करना
examples: Please inform the team.
I'll inform you of the result.
The airline informed us that the flight was delayed by two hours.
Please inform HR if you will be on leave next week.

cards.def:
to formally tell someone
हिंदी: अधिसूचित करना / सूचना देना
examples: We will notify you by SMS.
Notify the manager immediately.
The bank notified me about a large withdrawal from my account.
Students will be notified of their exam dates by email.

cards.def:
to tell someone
हिंदी: किसी को बता देना
examples: Let me know when you arrive.
I'll let her know.
If you need any help with the move, just let me know.
Please let the client know that the delivery will be late.

cards.def:
to give a message to another person
हिंदी: आगे पहुँचा देना
examples: Please pass on my regards.
I'll pass on the message.
My mother asked me to pass on her best wishes to your family.
Could you pass on these files to the new joiner?

cards.def:
to pass information from one to another
हिंदी: संदेश आगे प्रेषित करना
examples: He relayed the instructions to the staff.
Can you relay this to Sam?
The captain relayed the weather update to the passengers.
I'll relay your feedback to the design team this afternoon.

cards.def:
to make people understand a message
हिंदी: बात समझा पाना
examples: It was hard to get my point across.
She got her message across.
Use a simple example to get your idea across to the audience.
The ad gets its message across in just ten seconds.

cards.def:
to give a certain impression
हिंदी: ऐसा प्रतीत होना
examples: He comes across as confident.
You came across as rude.
I don't want to come across as rude in my emails.
She comes across as shy, but she's very friendly.

cards.def:
to explain in clear detail
हिंदी: खुलकर विस्तार से बताना
examples: Let me spell out the rules.
He spelled out the plan.
The contract spells out the payment terms clearly.
Do I need to spell out every step, or can you manage?

cards.def:
to explain without confusion
हिंदी: स्पष्ट करना
examples: I made it clear that I disagreed.
Make clear what you expect.
The teacher made clear that phones are not allowed in class.
Please make clear in the email who should reply.

cards.def:
to say in simple, direct words
हिंदी: सीधे शब्दों में कहना
examples: To put it plainly, we can't afford it.
Let me put it plainly.
To put it plainly, the project is over budget.
Let me put it plainly: we need your decision today.

cards.def:
using simple language
हिंदी: सरल शब्दों में
examples: Say it in plain words.
In plain words, we need more time.
The doctor explained my illness in plain words.
In plain words, the new policy means less overtime pay.

cards.def:
to give only the main point
हिंदी: संक्षेप में कहें तो
examples: Long story short, we lost the deal.
Long story short, I quit.
Long story short, I missed the train and took a cab.
Long story short, the client loved our proposal.

cards.word: to cut a long story short
cards.def:
to skip details and summarise
हिंदी: कहानी छोटी करूँ तो
examples: To cut a long story short, he refused.
To cut a long story short, it failed.
To cut a long story short, we moved to Pune last year.
To cut a long story short, the meeting was cancelled.

cards.def:
in very few words
हिंदी: संक्षेप में
examples: In a nutshell, we need funding.
That is, in a nutshell, the plan.
In a nutshell, the new phone is faster and cheaper.
Can you explain the problem in a nutshell?

cards.def:
the most important final point
हिंदी: सारांश / असली बात
examples: The bottom line is we need more staff.
The bottom line — it works.
The bottom line is that customers want faster delivery.
Forget the details; what's the bottom line?

cards.def:
the main idea of something
हिंदी: सार
examples: I got the gist of the story.
Tell me the gist.
I missed the meeting, so can you give me the gist?
The gist of the article is that prices will rise.

cards.def:
introducing the main idea
हिंदी: मुद्दा यह है कि
examples: The point is we are late.
The point is, we can't wait.
The point is, we need to save money this year.
I know it's hard, but the point is to keep trying.

cards.def:
clarifying your meaning
हिंदी: मेरा मतलब है
examples: What I mean is we need a plan.
What I mean is, try again.
What I mean is that we should test before launching.
Sorry, that sounded wrong; what I mean is I need more time.

cards.def:
saying the same thing differently
हिंदी: दूसरे शब्दों में
examples: In other words, we must wait.
In other words, it's cancelled.
The shop is closed on Sundays; in other words, come on Monday.
He said he's very busy, in other words, he can't help.

cards.def:
used to explain or restate
हिंदी: यानी कि
examples: That is to say, we agree.
It's free, that is to say, no charge.
The meeting is next week, that is to say, on the twelfth.
We'll work remotely, that is to say, from home.

cards.def:
to give exact details
हिंदी: सटीक रूप से
examples: He arrived at six, to be precise.
To be precise, there were forty.
The flight takes two hours, forty minutes, to be precise.
To be precise, we sold 1,245 tickets yesterday.

cards.def:
speaking openly and honestly
हिंदी: साफ़ कहूँ तो
examples: Frankly speaking, I don't like it.
Frankly speaking, it's too costly.
Frankly speaking, the food here is overpriced.
Frankly speaking, I'm not ready for a promotion yet.

cards.def:
stating something less strongly than the truth
हिंदी: नरमी से कहूँ तो
examples: It was, to put it mildly, a disaster.
He was upset, to put it mildly.
The traffic was bad, to put it mildly.
The client was unhappy, to put it mildly, about the delay.

cards.def:
a polite way to give an opinion
हिंदी: अगर मैं कह सकूँ तो
examples: It's a great idea, if I may say so.
If I may say so, it's too long.
If I may say so, your English has improved a lot.
That colour suits you, if I may say so.

cards.def:
politely before disagreeing
हिंदी: पूरे सम्मान के साथ
examples: With all due respect, I disagree.
With all due respect, that's wrong.
With all due respect, the numbers don't support that plan.
With all due respect, sir, I think we need more time.

cards.def:
politely introducing a fact
हिंदी: मैं ध्यान दिलाना चाहूँगा
examples: I'd like to point out a mistake.
I'd like to point out the cost.
I'd like to point out that the deadline is tomorrow.
Before we decide, I'd like to point out one risk.

cards.def:
politely recalling something
हिंदी: क्या मैं याद दिला सकता हूँ
examples: May I remind you of the deadline?
May I remind you of our agreement?
May I remind you that phones must be switched off?
May I remind you that the payment is overdue?

cards.def:
drawing attention to information
हिंदी: कृपया ध्यान दें कि
examples: Please note that the office is closed.
Please note that fees apply.
Please note that the meeting room has changed to the third floor.
Please note that late submissions will not be accepted.

cards.def:
a polite request to verify
हिंदी: कृपया पुष्टि करें
examples: Kindly confirm your attendance.
Kindly confirm receipt.
Kindly confirm the delivery address before we ship the order.
Kindly confirm whether you can join the call at four.

cards.def:
a standard opening of a formal letter
हिंदी: मैं ... के लिए लिख रहा हूँ
examples: I'm writing to enquire about the job.
I'm writing to confirm our meeting.
I'm writing to apply for the marketing role.
I'm writing to complain about a faulty washing machine.

cards.def:
in connection with
हिंदी: ... के संदर्भ में
examples: With reference to your email, I'm replying.
With reference to our call, here's the plan.
With reference to your order, the delivery will arrive Monday.
With reference to the job ad, I'd like to apply.

cards.def:
following on from
हिंदी: ... के क्रम में
examples: Further to our meeting, I've attached notes.
Further to your request, here is the file.
Further to my last email, here is the updated price list.
Further to our phone call, I've booked the meeting room.

cards.def:
as we talked about earlier
हिंदी: जैसा कि चर्चा हुई थी
examples: As discussed, I'll send the invoice.
As discussed, the meeting is on Friday.
As discussed, I've shared the draft with the team.
As discussed in the meeting, we'll launch in March.

cards.def:
according to
हिंदी: ... के अनुसार
examples: As per your request, I've resent it.
As per the policy, leave needs approval.
As per the schedule, the train leaves at nine.
As per our agreement, payment is due within thirty days.

cards.def:
used when sending a file by email
हिंदी: कृपया संलग्न देखें
examples: Please find attached the report.
Please find attached my CV.
Please find attached the invoice for last month.
Please find attached the photos from the event.

cards.def:
expressing eager anticipation
हिंदी: मैं ... की प्रतीक्षा करता हूँ
examples: I look forward to your reply.
I look forward to meeting you.
I look forward to working with you on this project.
We look forward to welcoming you to our office.

cards.def:
as soon as it suits you
हिंदी: आपकी सुविधानुसार जल्द से जल्द
examples: Please reply at your earliest convenience.
Call me at your earliest convenience.
Please sign the form and return it at your earliest convenience.
Kindly review the draft at your earliest convenience.

cards.def:
to reply later
हिंदी: मुझे जवाब दीजिए
examples: Please get back to me by Friday.
Get back to me when you can.
Can you get back to me with a price by tomorrow?
I'll check with my team and get back to you.

cards.def:
to send a short message
हिंदी: मुझे दो पंक्तियाँ लिख भेजिए
examples: Drop me a line when you land.
Drop me a line sometime.
Drop me a line if you're ever in Delhi.
If you have questions, just drop me a line.

cards.def:
to keep updating me
हिंदी: मुझे ख़बर देते रहिए
examples: Keep me posted on the progress.
Keep me posted about the result.
Keep me posted on your job search.
I'll keep you posted if the plan changes.

cards.def:
to keep me informed
हिंदी: मुझे जानकारी में रखिए
examples: Please keep me in the loop.
Keep me in the loop on this.
Keep me in the loop on any client emails this week.
She felt left out because nobody kept her in the loop.

cards.def:
to warn or inform in advance
हिंदी: पहले से आगाह करना
examples: I'll give you a heads-up before I leave.
Give them a heads-up.
Thanks for the heads-up about the traffic jam.
Give the team a heads-up before you change the schedule.

cards.def:
to tell someone important or bad news
हिंदी: ख़बर सुनाना
examples: I had to break the news to her.
Who will break the news?
The doctor broke the news gently to the family.
I don't know how to break the news that I'm leaving.

cards.def:
to pass on a message formally
हिंदी: संदेश पहुँचाना
examples: He delivered the message to the board.
I'll deliver your message.
The secretary delivered the message to the director in person.
Please deliver the message before the meeting starts.

cards.def:
information spread by people talking
हिंदी: मुँहज़बानी प्रचार
examples: The shop grew by word of mouth.
We heard it by word of mouth.
Most of our customers find us through word of mouth.
Good restaurants don't need ads; word of mouth is enough.

cards.def:
to tell many people
हिंदी: बात फैलाना
examples: Please spread the word about the event.
Help us spread the word.
Spread the word: free coffee in the canteen today!
We need volunteers, so please spread the word.

cards.def:
to publicly state something
हिंदी: घोषणा करना
examples: The principal made an announcement.
They made an announcement at noon.
The CEO will make an announcement at the town hall.
The pilot made an announcement about the delay.

cards.def:
to show a feeling or opinion in words
हिंदी: व्यक्त करना
examples: She expressed her gratitude.
He expressed concern.
It's hard for him to express his feelings.
Please express your ideas freely in this meeting.

cards.def:
to say a feeling or opinion aloud
हिंदी: आवाज़ उठाना
examples: He voiced his doubts.
Voice your concerns.
Several parents voiced their anger about the fee hike.
The survey lets employees voice their opinions anonymously.

cards.def:
to express so others understand
हिंदी: समझाकर कहना
examples: He puts his ideas across well.
She put her view across clearly.
She puts complex ideas across in very simple words.
He struggled to put his point across in English.

cards.def:
to understand what is being communicated
हिंदी: इशारा / संदेश समझना
examples: I got the message loud and clear.
He didn't get the message.
After three reminders, he finally got the message and paid.
She didn't reply to my calls, so I got the message.

cards.def:
to understand the hidden meaning
हिंदी: पंक्तियों के बीच का मतलब समझना
examples: You have to read between the lines.
I read between the lines of his email.
Reading between the lines, the company is cutting costs.
Her reply was polite, but if you read between the lines, she was upset.

cards.def:
to suggest indirectly
हिंदी: इशारा करना
examples: He hinted at a promotion.
She hinted that she was leaving.
The manager hinted at changes in the team structure.
The trailer hints at a surprise ending.

cards.def:
to speak about or point to
हिंदी: उल्लेख करना / संदर्भ देना
examples: He referred to the report.
I'm referring to last week's event.
Please refer to the attached document for details.
Which client were you referring to in the meeting?

cards.def:
to start talking about a topic
हिंदी: बात छेड़ना
examples: Don't bring up the past.
He brought up the budget.
I'll bring up the leave issue in my one-on-one.
She brought up an important point about safety.

cards.def:
to mention briefly
हिंदी: संक्षेप में चर्चा करना
examples: She touched on the main issues.
He touched on pricing.
The speaker touched on climate change at the end of her talk.
We only touched on the budget; we'll discuss it next week.

cards.def:
to explain fully
हिंदी: विस्तार से बताना
examples: I won't go into detail.
Can you go into detail?
The report goes into detail about last year's sales.
There's no time to go into detail, so here's the summary.

cards.def:
to make something understandable
हिंदी: समझाना
examples: Explain how it works.
She explained the rules.
Can you explain why the payment failed?
The teacher explained the maths problem twice.

cards.def:
to restate in different words
हिंदी: अपने शब्दों में दोहराना
examples: Please paraphrase the paragraph.
He paraphrased her statement.
Don't copy the article; paraphrase it in your own words.
Let me paraphrase what you said to check I understood.

cards.def:
to repeat the main points
हिंदी: सारांश दोहराना
examples: Let me quickly recap.
A short recap of the plan.
Here's a quick recap of yesterday's meeting.
Let's recap the action items before we leave.

cards.def:
to stress the importance
हिंदी: रेखांकित करना
examples: The incident underlines the need for caution.
He underlined the risk.
The flood underlines the need for better drainage.
The manager underlined the importance of safety rules.

cards.def:
to repeat for emphasis
हिंदी: दोहराना
examples: I reiterate my position.
Let me reiterate the deadline.
The teacher reiterated that the exam starts at nine sharp.
I want to reiterate how grateful we are for your support.

cards.def:
to strengthen a message
हिंदी: मज़बूत करना
examples: The speaker reinforced his point.
Examples reinforce the message.
Practice reinforces what you learn in class.
The second email reinforced the message about the deadline.

cards.def:
to keep repeating the main point
हिंदी: मूल संदेश पर टिके रहना
examples: The politician stayed on message.
Stay on message during the interview.
The spokesperson stayed on message despite tough questions.
In sales calls, stay on message about the main benefit.

cards.def:
the attitude conveyed by how something is said
हिंदी: लहज़ा
examples: His tone was polite.
Watch your tone.
The tone of her email sounded a bit angry.
Keep a friendly tone when you reply to customers.

cards.def:
messages conveyed through gestures
हिंदी: हाव-भाव / देह-भाषा
examples: Her body language showed she was nervous.
Body language says a lot.
Crossed arms are body language that can look defensive.
Good body language helps in job interviews.

cards.def:
looking into another's eyes while speaking
हिंदी: आँख से आँख मिलाना
examples: Maintain eye contact while speaking.
He avoided eye contact.
Eye contact shows you're listening.
In some cultures, too much eye contact can feel rude.

cards.def:
to make less strong
हिंदी: नरम करना
examples: Tone down your language.
Please tone down the message.
The editor asked him to tone down the headline.
Can you tone down the colours on this slide?

cards.def:
to make bad news less shocking
हिंदी: बुरी ख़बर को नरम बनाना
examples: He tried to soften the blow.
A kind word softened the blow.
The company offered a good severance package to soften the blow.
She softened the blow by praising his effort first.

cards.def:
to make something unpleasant seem better
हिंदी: मीठा बनाकर कहना
examples: Don't sugarcoat the truth.
He didn't sugarcoat the results.
My doctor doesn't sugarcoat bad news.
Please don't sugarcoat the feedback; I want to improve.

cards.def:
to avoid speaking directly
हिंदी: इधर-उधर की बात करना
examples: Stop beating around the bush.
He beat around the bush.
Don't beat around the bush; tell me what happened.
He beat around the bush instead of asking for a raise.

cards.def:
to say the main thing directly
हिंदी: मुद्दे पर आना
examples: Please get to the point.
Let me get to the point.
We have five minutes, so please get to the point.
Her emails always get to the point in the first line.

cards.def:
to say something louder or openly
हिंदी: खुलकर बोलना / ऊँची आवाज़ में कहना
examples: Speak up, we can't hear.
He spoke up against the plan.
If you disagree, please speak up in the meeting.
Can you speak up a little? The line is bad.

cards.def:
to say publicly what you think
हिंदी: खुलकर सार्वजनिक रूप से बोलना
examples: She spoke out against abuse.
Many spoke out for change.
Few employees dared to speak out against the policy.
The actor spoke out about mental health.

cards.def:
to say honestly what you think
हिंदी: मन की बात कहना
examples: Feel free to speak your mind.
He always speaks his mind.
My grandmother always speaks her mind at family dinners.
In our team, you can speak your mind without fear.

cards.def:
to start talking about feelings
हिंदी: मन खोलकर बात करना
examples: She finally opened up to me.
He opened up about his fears.
It took months before the new joiner opened up to the team.
Children open up more when you listen without judging.

cards.def:
to try to contact someone
हिंदी: संपर्क साधना
examples: I reached out to the manager.
Please reach out to us.
Reach out to IT if your laptop isn't working.
She reached out to old colleagues for job leads.

cards.def:
to contact someone
हिंदी: संपर्क करना
examples: Get in touch if you have questions.
I'll get in touch soon.
How can I get in touch with customer support?
Get in touch with me after you reach Mumbai.

cards.def:
to keep contact regularly
हिंदी: संपर्क बनाए रखना
examples: Let's stay in touch.
We stayed in touch for years.
We stay in touch through a family WhatsApp group.
It's hard to stay in touch with college friends after moving.

cards.def:
meaning lost when changing language
हिंदी: अनुवाद में अर्थ खो जाना
examples: Something got lost in translation.
The joke was lost in translation.
The film's humour got lost in translation.
Some instructions got lost in translation between the two offices.

cards.def:
failure to communicate properly
हिंदी: ग़लत संप्रेषण / संवादहीनता
examples: It was a case of miscommunication.
Miscommunication caused the delay.
A small miscommunication led to two people doing the same task.
Clear emails help avoid miscommunication.

cards.def:
a failure to understand correctly
हिंदी: ग़लतफ़हमी
examples: It was just a misunderstanding.
There was a misunderstanding.
Sorry for the misunderstanding; I thought the meeting was at four.
The misunderstanding was cleared up with a quick call.

cards.def:
in agreement or understanding
हिंदी: एकमत होना / एक ही समझ पर
examples: Are we all on the same page?
We're on the same page now.
Let's get on the same page about the budget first.
The client and our team weren't on the same page about the scope.

cards.def:
easily and fully understood
हिंदी: बिल्कुल साफ़-साफ़
examples: I got the message loud and clear.
The message came through loud and clear.
Can you hear me? Yes, loud and clear.
The customers' complaints were loud and clear.

cards.def:
extremely easy to understand
हिंदी: एकदम स्पष्ट
examples: The instructions were crystal clear.
It's crystal clear to me.
She made it crystal clear that she wasn't interested.
The new rules are crystal clear: no phones at the desk.

cards.def:
to state the main points briefly
हिंदी: सार में कहना
examples: Can you sum it up in one line?
Let me sum it up for you.
To sum it up, the trip was tiring but fun.
Can someone sum it up for those who joined late?

cards.def:
direct without extra words
हिंदी: सीधी बात
examples: Her email was straight to the point.
Keep your message straight to the point.
Her answers were straight to the point, and the interviewer liked that.
His feedback was straight to the point but kind.

cards.def:
using exactly the same words
हिंदी: शब्दशः
examples: He repeated it word for word.
She quoted him word for word.
The student copied the answer word for word from the book.
Please write down what the customer said word for word.

cards.def:
stating something directly
हिंदी: साफ़ शब्दों में
examples: He didn't say it in so many words.
She said, in so many words, no.
She didn't say it in so many words, but she wants a raise.
He told me, in so many words, that I was fired.
